rows.definition: Binds one execution Role to its own modelroute Subject (independent model constraints), an independent per-axis Budget, an escalation target, and a result fold.
rows.distinction: One role's routing-plus-budget contract; unlike RolePlanSet it is a single member of the set, and unlike modelroute.Plan it carries the role, its budget, and its escalation target rather than only the chosen model policy.

rows.definition: The declared multi-role execution plan: an ordered list of RolePlans plus a top-level fold that composes the roles' results into the final answer.
rows.distinction: The whole declared set; unlike RolePlan it is the ordered collection (not one member), and unlike RoleEnvelope it is the pre-execution declaration, not the resolved post-budget decisions.

rows.definition: agent.InKernelPlannerConfig is the typed bundle of native planner and session settings fixed at construction, including Qwen Q4_K prefill chunking, Qwen3.5 Metal GDN sequencing, CPU expert offload, and the Q4_K gate/up output slab.
rows.distinction: This is configuration supplied to a native planner, not InKernelPlanner, the runtime planner that owns request state, and not NewInKernelPlannerWithConfig, the constructor that consumes the configuration.

rows.definition: agent.NewInKernelPlannerWithConfig constructs the local in-kernel planner from a loaded model plus an explicit InKernelPlannerConfig, fixing operator-selected native behavior before any request session is created.
rows.distinction: This is the constructor that consumes explicit typed settings; unlike NewInKernelPlanner it is not the compatibility constructor with only CPU-offload input, and unlike InKernelPlannerConfig it performs construction rather than representing settings.

rows.definition: workerworktree.landCandidateCapture is the internal variant interface that lets one isolated candidate construction persist either the established verified receipt or the distinct pending-debt receipt.
rows.distinction: A receipt-capture adapter inside atomic landing; it does not select work, plan an agent task, authorize publication, or turn pending debt into verification.

rows.definition: workerworktree.persistCandidateLand is the landCandidateCapture method that persists the chosen verified or pending receipt variant for the exact already-constructed candidate.
rows.distinction: A persistence hook after candidate construction; it does not create a user plan, choose a candidate, verify one, acknowledge debt, or perform the target-ref CAS.

rows.definition: Name of the fak_engine_planner_step_seconds histogram: the duration of one planner-step leg over the closed StepKind vocabulary.
rows.distinction: The PLANNER-LEG histogram. fak_engine_phase_seconds times a whole serving cycle and fak_engine_kernel_seconds times one GEMM, so this is the only one of the three whose label is a step KIND rather than a phase or a kernel.

rows.definition: Name of the fak_engine_planner_step_events_total counter: how many planner-step legs of each closed kind have been observed.
rows.distinction: The COUNT companion to the leg duration histogram. fak_engine_kernel_calls_total counts GEMM invocations, not planner legs, so a reader must not divide one series by the other.

rows.definition: Name of the fak_engine_planner_step_kind_overflow_total counter: planner-step legs dropped because their kind fell outside the closed StepKind vocabulary.
rows.distinction: The KIND-bound overflow for the planner seam. fak_engine_kernel_keys_capped and fak_engine_kernel_event_overflow_total bound the KERNEL label set by count; this bounds the planner label set by vocabulary, because the planner side is closed and never grows.

rows.definition: Recorder method that folds one planner-step leg of a closed StepKind and its duration into the planner-step registry, counting and dropping any out-of-vocabulary kind.
rows.distinction: The PLANNER ingress. ObserveKernel is the compute-side ingress, and ObserveEnginePhase is the typed adapter that projects a native serving phase onto the closed kind vocabulary; this method takes the kind already resolved.

rows.definition: The closed-vocabulary fold inside internal/stepobs that turns planner-step legs into per-kind histograms and counters, dropping any kind outside the closed StepKind set.
rows.distinction: The PLANNER half of the stepobs Recorder, whose other half is the kernel registry; because its vocabulary is closed it pre-allocates every series, so a cold render emits all of them at a real zero instead of omitting them.

rows.definition: The read-only output of fak optimize plan (internal/optimize.OptimizePlan): the next dependency-ready unwitnessed lever from the committed native-performance hill-climb graph plus the exact follow-on measure and verify invocations and the lever's expected planning band.
rows.distinction: The DRIVER verb's plan artifact naming the next lever and its exact commands - NOT the committed lever graph itself (nativeperf.Graph), NOT the per-wave execution plan dispatchwaveexecutionplan, and NOT the umbrella plan domain.

rows.definition: The profile-classified selection route optimize.BuildPlanFromProfile (internal/optimize): picks the lever the native profile classifier names instead of graph order, then emits the same OptimizePlan artifact with that lever's measure and verify commands.
rows.distinction: The PROFILE-CLASSIFIED route into OptimizePlan - NOT the default graph-order selection BuildPlan and NOT the nativeperf profile classifier itself, which only names the lever.

rows.definition: The closed optimize refusal class optimize.ClassNoPlanningBand: verify refuses when the lever has no registered planning band to judge the candidate against - a typed refusal, never a guessed verdict.
rows.distinction: One closed refusal CLASS in the optimize verb family's vocabulary - NOT the missing band itself and NOT the no_arm_mapping class that measure refuses with when the lever has no trace-backed arm.

rows.definition: The fak optimize loop ledger verdict constant optimize.LedgerPlanned: the iteration stopped at plan (dry-run or an upstream refusal) so no measurement exists and the throughput fields are omitted rather than zero-filled.
rows.distinction: A loop LEDGER state meaning planned-only, nothing measured - NOT the verify verdict VerdictAccept or VerdictReject and NOT the LedgerRefused ledger state that carries a refusal class.

rows.definition: The internal binding optimize.planningRungs that projects a lever's expected floor and roof band from the native-performance graph rungs the lever is planned against, feeding verify's banded criterion.
rows.distinction: The band-BINDING helper over committed graph rungs - NOT the rungs themselves (nativeperf graph data) and NOT the comparison criterion nativeperf resolves for nativeperf experiment receipts.

rows.definition: The single-lever arm throughput optimize.OptimizeReceipt.CandidateTokS: end-to-end decode tok/s replayed from the frozen trace with the lever's mapped ablate feature enabled, paired against BaselineTokS, the all-off arm.
rows.distinction: The measured CANDIDATE arm of the optimize A/B - NOT the all-off baseline arm BaselineTokS and NOT a predicted or roof value from the planning band.
